snippet.title: Miniland - Demo Gameplay | Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
⭐CHECK OUT THE DEMO: ⭐
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/?beta=0

Hi dear fans of Miniland!
If you see this video, that means that Steam Next Fest has begun (or even ended if you're reading from further future) and will last until 10th of October.

I have prepared the demo version for Next Fest which ANYONE can play completely for FREE! Just open the link below and download it through Steam.

Have a good time either watching the video or playing the demo by yourself! Best doing both 💪
